```{r Load clean_names_lowercase function}
clean_names_lowercase <- function(x) {

  x <- iconv(x, from = "", to = "UTF-8", sub = "")
  x <- stringi::stri_trans_general(x, "Latin-ASCII")

  x %>%
    tolower() %>%
    trimws()
}
```

```{r Major_Functional_Group patch for GOC_MarineLandings}
  left_join(
```

# STEP 2: Review & Plot Sector Data ------------------------------

```{r Generate GOC_MarineSector_summary}
colnames(GOC_MarineFisheryLandings)

GOC_MarineSector_summary<- GOC_MarineFisheryLandings %>%
  select(year, 
         state, office_name, landing_site,
         sector_estimate_draft,
         GOC_Include_Exclude, OHI_rgn_id, OHI_rgn_name,
         eu_rnpa, eu_name, sector_estimate_draft, 
         Major_Functional_Group, recorded_taxa_group, estimated_taxa_group,
         recorded_taxa_name, recorded_taxa_name_clean,

GOC_MarineSector_summary<- GOC_MarineSector_summary %>%
  group_by(year, OHI_rgn_id, sector_estimate_draft) %>%
  summarize(
```

```{r Load in Stock_Statuses0 scores as necessary}
Stock_Statuses0<- read.csv("/home/ferrer/ohi_goc_prep/FP/v2026/FP_Scores_1.1/FIS_Scores_1.1/Stock_Statuses_Compiled_df_Oct282026.csv")
# 13008 obs., 23 vars.

```

```{r Prep Stock_Statuses}
colnames(Stock_Statuses0)

Stock_Statuses <- Stock_Statuses0 %>%
  filter(year >= START_EVAL_PERIOD, year <= END_EVAL_PERIOD) %>%
  mutate(
    estimated_genus_name = clean_names_lowercase(estimated_genus_name)
  )
# 4596 obs., 23 vars.
```

```{r Load in revised MajorGroup_KEY0}
MajorGroup_KEY0<- read_csv("/home/ferrer/ohi_goc_prep/FP/v2026/CONAPESCA_Keys/Taxonomic_Keys/Older_Outdated_Keys/MajorGroupKey_Mar252026.csv")
# 526 obs. 13 vars.

colnames(MajorGroup_KEY0)
table(MajorGroup_KEY0$estimated_taxa_group)

# Patch the small pelagics:
SMALL_PELAGICS<- c("ANCHOVETA", "SARDINA") 

MajorGroup_KEY <- MajorGroup_KEY0 %>%
  mutate(
    estimated_genus_name =
      clean_names_lowercase(estimated_genus_name),
    
    Major_Functional_Group = case_when(
      recorded_taxa_group %in% SMALL_PELAGICS ~ "Anchovy & Sardine (small pelagics)",
      Major_Functional_Group == "Pelagic marine fishes" ~ "Pelagic marine fish (excl. anchovy & sardine)",
      TRUE ~ Major_Functional_Group
      ),
    # PATCH oligoplites:
    Major_Functional_Group = case_when(
      estimated_genus_name == "oligoplites" ~ "Anchovy & Sardine (small pelagics)",
      TRUE ~ Major_Functional_Group
    )
  )

# Trim down the key:
MajorGroup_KEY <- MajorGroup_KEY %>%
  select(
    estimated_genus_name,
    Major_Functional_Group
  ) %>%
  distinct()
# 257

# Find keys with multiple functional group assignments
MajorGroup_KEY_conflicts <- MajorGroup_KEY %>%
  group_by(
    estimated_genus_name
  ) %>%
  summarise(
    n_functional_groups = n_distinct(
      Major_Functional_Group,
      na.rm = FALSE
    ),
    functional_groups = paste(
      sort(unique(as.character(Major_Functional_Group))),
      collapse = "; "
    ),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  filter(n_functional_groups > 1) %>%
  arrange(desc(n_functional_groups))

MajorGroup_KEY_conflicts

# Remove the conflicts from the key:
MajorGroup_KEY <- MajorGroup_KEY %>%
  select(
    estimated_genus_name,
    Major_Functional_Group
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    estimated_genus_name =
      clean_names_lowercase(estimated_genus_name)
  ) %>%
  distinct() %>%
  anti_join(
    MajorGroup_KEY_conflicts %>%
      select(
        estimated_genus_name
      ),
    by = c(
      "estimated_genus_name"
    )
  )

# 217 obs.
```

```{r Merge MajorGroup_KEY to Stock_Statuses0}
colnames(Stock_Statuses0)

Stock_Statuses<- Stock_Statuses %>%
  left_join(
    MajorGroup_KEY,
    by= c("estimated_genus_name")
  )
# 13008 obs., 17 vars. (good!)

table(Stock_Statuses$Major_Functional_Group.x)
```

# PATCH 3 - Re-assign values with no estimated_genus_name 
```{r Re-assign values with no estimated_genus_name}
unique(GOC_SSF_Landings$estimated_genus_name)

no_genus <- c("unknown", "NEI", "Especies")

GOC_SSF_Landings <- GOC_SSF_Landings %>%
  mutate(
    estimated_genus_name = case_when(
      is.na(estimated_genus_name) |
        estimated_genus_name %in% no_genus ~ "no_genus",
      TRUE ~ estimated_genus_name
    )
  )
# 977477 obs., 22 vars.
```

```{r Create SSF_Landings_summary}
SSF_Landings_summary <- GOC_SSF_Landings %>%
  group_by(year, OHI_region_est, estimated_genus_name) %>%
  summarize(
    total_landings_mt = sum(weight_kg_corrected, na.rm = TRUE)/1000,
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    estimated_genus_name= clean_names_lowercase(estimated_genus_name),
    OHI_region_est= clean_names_lowercase(OHI_region_est)
  )
# 4108 obs., 4 vars.
```

```{r Merge Stock_Statuses to SSF_Landings_summary}
colnames(Stock_Statuses)

AFO_df0 <- SSF_Landings_summary %>%
  left_join(
    Stock_Statuses %>%
      select(
        OHI_region_est,
        year,
        estimated_genus_name,
        StockStatus_final,
        StockStatus_source,
        StockStatus_est.level
      ),
    by = c(
      "year",
      "estimated_genus_name",
      "OHI_region_est"
    )
  )

# 4108 obs. (as expected!), 7 vars.

AFO_df0<- AFO_df0 %>%
  filter(year <= END_EVAL_PERIOD)
# 3657 obs., 7 vars.
```

# **DECISION POINT: Gapfilling missing StockStatus_final values**
```{r Gap-fill}
colnames(AFO_df0)

AFO_df <- AFO_df0 %>%
  group_by(year, OHI_region_est) %>%
  mutate(
    regional_StockStatus = mean(StockStatus_final, na.rm = TRUE),
   
    StockStatus_missing = is.na(StockStatus_final),
    
    StockStatus_final = coalesce(StockStatus_final, regional_StockStatus),
    StockStatus_source = if_else(
      StockStatus_missing,
      "Gapfill: mean stock status in that region that year",
      StockStatus_source
    ),
    StockStatus_est.level = if_else(
      StockStatus_missing,
      "region level",
      StockStatus_est.level
    )
  ) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  select(-regional_StockStatus, -StockStatus_missing)
```

# **DECISION POINT: Do not exclude values missing a genus**
```{r How much of the biomass is unassigned at the genus level?}
table(AFO_df$estimated_genus_name)

unassigned <- AFO_df %>%
  mutate(is_no_genus = estimated_genus_name == "no_genus") %>%
  group_by(year, OHI_region_est) %>%
  summarise(
    total_landings_mt_sum = sum(total_landings_mt, na.rm = TRUE),

    no_genus_landings_mt = sum(
      total_landings_mt[is_no_genus],
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),

    pct_no_genus = 100 * no_genus_landings_mt / total_landings_mt_sum,
    .groups = "drop"
  )
# About 55% of landings in Region_6 are unassigned at the genus level in 2025...
```


# STEP 5: Calculate AFO Scores ------------------------------
Calculate scores per region!!
Not a weighted average, just a normal average across stocks.

```{r Calculate AFO_Scores}
colnames(AFO_df)

AFO_Scores <- AFO_df %>%
  group_by(year, OHI_region_est) %>%
  summarise(
    total_landings_mt = sum(total_landings_mt, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_StockStatus = mean(StockStatus_final, na.rm = TRUE),
    #common_StockStatus_source = mode_fun(StockStatus_source),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    AFO_Score = total_landings_mt * mean_StockStatus
  )

# 3475 obs. (as expected), 25 varsity.

AFO_Scores <- AFO_df %>%
  group_by(year, OHI_region_est) %>%
  summarise(
    AFO_Score = 100 * sum(StockStatus_final * total_landings_mt, na.rm = TRUE) /
                    sum(total_landings_mt, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )
```

```{r Sanity check AFO_Scores}
colnames(AFO_Scores)

nrow(AFO_Scores)

summary(AFO_Scores$AFO_Score)
  #  Min. 1st Qu.  Median    Mean 3rd Qu.    Max. 
  # 38.93   73.30   80.08   79.12   86.35   98.39 
```

```{r Plot what they are catching in Region 7 and 8}
Region78_plot<- Region78_summary %>%
  filter(year >= START_EVAL_PERIOD & year <= END_EVAL_PERIOD) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = year, y = total_weight_mt, group= OHI_region_est)) +
  
    geom_col(
    aes(color= OHI_region_est, fill= OHI_region_est), 
    position = position_dodge(width = 0.8),
    width = 0.7
  ) +
  
  # Colors (most useful when grouping by Major_Functional_Group)
  # scale_fill_manual(values = mfg_cols) +
  # scale_color_manual(values = mfg_cols) +

  # Labels
  labs(
    x = "Year",
    y = "Annual Catch (metric tons)",
    title = "Catch by Major_Functional_Group (Regions 7 and 8)"
  ) +
  
  facet_wrap(~Major_Functional_Group) +
  
  # Minimal theme and sleek styling
  theme_bw(base_size = 14) +
  theme(
    legend.position = "bottom",
    legend.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 12),
    axis.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.major = element_line(color = "grey85"),
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 16),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 13, color = "grey30")
  )

Region78_plot
```
